1140.note: OG/BB/492 is not an Oglander letter but a copy (Isle of Wight Record Office) of Charles I's own letter from Newport to Prince Charles, 6 Nov 1648, 'partly in code', and Charles I's 6 and 7 Nov 1648 letters to his son in that nomenclator were solved in 2021 (Biermann, Bosbach, Brown), so the cipher is read, though the IWRO leaf itself was not seen to match word for word.

The lead's 'access' field is empty; the item is offline (digitised: false).
seen.extent: One copy letter, dated 6 Nov 1648, no. 78/5; how many cipher groups it contains is not stated.
seen.cipher: Discovery title: 'Copy letter from King Charles I at Newport, I.W., to his son, Charles'; description: 'Acknowledging his letter of 17th October... the treaty is postponed for 14 days ... if Osborne (who has beene in trouble for me about Major Rolphes business) comes to you, use him well for my sake. [Letter partly in code] (78/5)'. The leaf was not seen; no decipherment is recorded with it, but the cipher is Charles I's nomenclator that was broken from the British Library originals.
